author: Patrick Garcia
text: I would recommend Royal T Rooter Service, they were a pleasure to work with. Nathaniel, did a great job and was very professional. They worked around my work schedule and called when they were on their way. They made an unpleasant situation, much easier to deal with.

author: Melvin Verdeyen
text: I tried to get my sink uncloged myself with no luck. This is the 1st time I haven't been able to do it myself. I called Royal T. They were recommended by my other plumber I have used. I  can say Effain did a fantastic job. Would definitely recommend them. Thanks for your help.

author: Kat Reeves
text: I have used Royal T Rooter for several years for my business, so when I ran into a clog at home, I knew who to call. The responded promptly to my call, as always, and promised to send a technician out same day. The technician did not arrive until 7:40 at night, but rather than pushing me off until another day, he made the effort so late to make sure he figured out what was going on. My fix turned out to be super easy, five minutes, and the technician refused to charge me. These are GOOD people. They have provided top notch service to me at my restaurant for years, they make sure the job is done right every time, and they are quality human beings. What more can you ask for?

author: Alannah Evans
text: They did fix the problem, but they left the place a mess with splattered feces over the toilet and smeared on the edge of the bath tub.

author: B Henton
text: Had them do a sewer line inspection.   Office staff was great.  They were helpful coordinating our inspection and ensured we got our report and video quickly.   The tech who came out (Jose) was amazing.   He and his assistant completed the scope  quickly and communicated throughout the condition of the line.  Would highly recommend
